# DaySight MCP

> DaySight MCP is a Workday MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets an AI assistant answer workforce analytics questions about a Workday tenant in plain English, with charts and dashboards. It runs as a desktop extension on the user's own computer, signs in with the user's own Workday account and only reads from Workday. Proprietary software (DaySight MCP Licence Agreement). The download is a free 30-day trial for each Workday tenant; a licence key is needed after that. Independent project, not affiliated with Workday, Inc.

- [Demos](https://daysight.dev/demos.html): short recorded demos
- [Install](https://daysight.dev/install.html): setup steps for Claude Desktop and the ChatGPT desktop app on Windows
- [Security](https://daysight.dev/security.html): access model, privacy and what stays local
- [Contact](https://daysight.dev/contact.html): contact details, legal notice, request a licence key after the 30-day trial, or ask a question
- [Install guide (PDF)](https://daysight.dev/downloads/daysight-mcp-install-guide.pdf): step-by-step guide for Claude Desktop and the ChatGPT desktop app
